articles.headline: FIFA agrees in principle to federation payments from WC windfall
articles.description: FIFA president Gianni Infantino has come out in favor of a tentative proposal from UEFA and Concacaf that FIFA distributes funds to member associations as a result of record revenues from this summer's World Cup.

articles.headline: Will anyone stop Infantino? FIFA president is confident U20 World Cup cameo says otherwise
articles.description: Under fire from UEFA, Infantino is back to business as usual and inching closer to reelection as FIFA president.

articles.headline: Vozinha struggling with World Cup fame: 'I'd choose the life I had before'
articles.description: Viral World Cup goalkeeper Vozinha has revealed he is struggling with his newfound fame, saying that he would like to go back to a time before he was so well-known.

articles.headline: Messi tracker: Goals, assists, key moments in 2026
articles.description: ESPN provides game-by-game analysis of Lionel Messi's performances for Inter Miami and Argentina.

articles.headline: If FIFA expands the World Cup again, how would a 64-team tournament work?
articles.description: The 2026 World Cup was the first to feature 48 teams, and 2030 could see the field swell to 64, but just how feasible is a tournament that size?
